title: Every roadmap writer is held to the note cap at commit, not only triage
why: Finding, Oct 27 (triage 8): other threads pushed notes over 250 words five times in one hour, and each blocked triage's next commit until triage trimmed someone else's note.
note: Landed Oct 28 on roadmap (2362640c, try 3): build.py --check-staged reads step files from the index and refuses a commit that adds or grows an open step's note past 250 words, naming it. Setup once per clone: `sh roadmap/hooks/install.sh`, never core.hooksPath (try 2's clone-wide hooksPath switched off main's main-ref guard in sibling worktrees); it chains an existing pre-commit and is a no-op outside a roadmap checkout; re-run it after a dispatcher change. 40 tests green; 3 Opus review rounds. Known: a merge or cherry-pick of a --no-verify commit is unchecked. Follow-up on main: c159. Port: no.
